panels.title: Busy %
panels.description: Share of the month with at least one request running (D11).

panels.title: Hours busy
panels.description: Hours with at least one request running, from the 15s recorded samples.

panels.title: Decode tok/s
panels.description: Per-request, token-weighted: tokens generated / seconds spent decoding (D12).

panels.title: Prefill tok/s
panels.description: Per-request, token-weighted: prefill tokens / seconds spent prefilling (D12).

panels.title: Tokens generated
panels.description: Decode tokens generated in the range.

panels.title: Energy (kWh)

targets.expr: sum by (box) (integrate(node_hwmon_power_average_watt{job="node", box=~"$box", node=~"$node"}[$__range]) or integrate(nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts{job="gpu-nvidia", box=~"$box", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) / 3.6e6

panels.description: GPU/APU package power integrated over the range: W*s / 3.6e6 = kWh. Not wall power. strix is amdgpu PPT from hwmon (one power sensor per box); sparks are nvidia-smi draw. VictoriaMetrics integrate() handles gaps.

panels.title: Busy %
panels.description: Share of the month with at least one request running (D11).

panels.title: Hours busy
panels.description: Hours with at least one request running, from the 15s recorded samples.

panels.title: Decode tok/s
panels.description: Per-request, token-weighted: tokens generated / seconds spent decoding (D12).

panels.title: Prefill tok/s
panels.description: Per-request, token-weighted: prefill tokens / seconds spent prefilling (D12).

panels.title: Tokens generated
panels.description: Decode tokens generated in the range.

panels.title: Energy (kWh)

targets.expr: sum by (box) (integrate(node_hwmon_power_average_watt{job="node", box=~"$box", node=~"$node"}[$__range]) or integrate(nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts{job="gpu-nvidia", box=~"$box", node=~"$node"}[$__range])) / 3.6e6

panels.description: GPU/APU package power integrated over the range: W*s / 3.6e6 = kWh. Not wall power. strix is amdgpu PPT from hwmon (one power sensor per box); sparks are nvidia-smi draw. VictoriaMetrics integrate() handles gaps.

panels.title: Busy %
panels.description: Share of time with at least one request running (D11).

panels.title: Slot occupancy %
panels.description: Mean running requests / slots: how full the slots are while in use.

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Requests queued or held until a lane is free.

panels.title: Decode tok/s (range)
panels.description: Tokens generated / seconds spent decoding over the selected range (D12).

panels.title: Prefill tok/s (range)
panels.description: Prefill tokens / seconds spent prefilling over the selected range (D12).

panels.title: Throughput (tokens/s, all slots together)
panels.description: Tokens per wall second across all slots. On tensorfold the counters only advance when a request finishes, so expect steps.

panels.title: Decode tok/s over time
panels.description: Per-request decode speed. Because the engine sums per-request seconds, two busy slots do not deflate this.

panels.title: Prefill tok/s over time
panels.description: Per-request prefill speed. tensorfold's *_seconds_sum only counts finished requests, so use [5m] or wider ranges.

panels.title: Request rate by outcome
panels.description: Finished requests per second. tensorfold has no single by-outcome counter: ok comes from the latency histogram count, cancelled from client disconnections, error from pair failures.

panels.title: Error ratio %

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (box) (rate(inference:requests_total{box=~"$box", node=~"$node", outcome="error"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (box) (rate(inference:requests_total{box=~"$box", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: outcome=error share of finished requests.

panels.title: Prompt-cache hit ratio %

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (box) (rate(inference:prompt_tokens_cached_total{box=~"$box", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (box) (rate(inference:prompt_tokens_total{box=~"$box", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Prompt tokens restored from cache / all prompt tokens.

panels.title: MTP acceptance ratio
panels.description: Speculative-decode acceptance (0..1).

panels.title: KV usage ratio
panels.description: strix: live tokens / (context length * slots). sparks: max KV cache usage across streams.

panels.title: Time to first token (sparks only)
panels.description: From tensorfold's histogram, which only counts finished requests. strix-infer exposes no TTFT metric, so the strix boxes are not on this panel. A strix estimate can be had from prefill_seconds_total / prefill_tokens_total, which is a rate, not a first-token latency.

panels.title: GPU busy %

targets.expr: node_drm_gpu_busy_percent{job="node", box=~"$box", node=~"$node"} or (100 * nvidia_smi_utilization_gpu_ratio{job="gpu-nvidia", box=~"$box", node=~"$node"})

panels.description: strix: node_exporter's drm collector. sparks: nvidia_gpu_exporter.

panels.title: GPU/APU package power (W)

targets.expr: ((node_hwmon_power_average_watt{job="node", box=~"$box", node=~"$node"} * on (instance, chip) group_left (chip_name) node_hwmon_chip_names{job="node", chip_name="amdgpu"}) or nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts{job="gpu-nvidia", box=~"$box", node=~"$node"})

panels.description: strix: amdgpu hwmon power1_average (PPT). sparks: nvidia-smi power draw. Neither is wall power.

panels.title: Memory (host RAM and GPU-visible)
panels.description: Unified memory: both boxes share RAM with the GPU. Host used is MemTotal-MemAvailable; gpu-visible is the amdgpu GTT aperture on strix and nvidia-smi's used memory on the sparks.

panels.title: CPU busy %
panels.description: 1 - idle, averaged over cores.

panels.title: Temperatures

targets.expr: (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{job="node", box=~"$box", node=~"$node"} * on (instance, chip) group_left (chip_name) node_hwmon_chip_names{job="node", chip_name="amdgpu"})
(node_hwmon_temp_celsius{job="node", box=~"$box", node=~"$node"} * on (instance, chip) group_left (chip_name) node_hwmon_chip_names{job="node", chip_name="k10temp"})

panels.description: amdgpu edge is the APU GPU temperature; GB10 publishes no junction limit and reports only the GPU number.

panels.title: Disk free (/ and model disk)
panels.description: / is the OS disk; /srv/models holds the strix model and prompt-cache data.

panels.title: Network receive
panels.description: Bytes per second received, summed over physical interfaces.

panels.title: Network transmit
panels.description: Bytes per second transmitted, summed over physical interfaces.
